title: AI-Guided Radiomics for Spectral-Domain OCT Characterization of Acquired Vitelliform Lesions: A Pilot Study.
summary: A radiomics logistic-regression classifier distinguished hypo-reflective spaces associated with reabsorbed material in acquired vitelliform lesions from subretinal fluid, using structural OCT; patient-level 75/25 holdout yielded AUC/PR-AUC 0.92. This is a small monocentric pilot. Published in Journal of Clinical Medicine.
ai_technology: 520 OCT radiomic features; robustness/variance/correlation filtering and feature selection yielded nine predictors; ridge logistic regression. 99 patients (60 aVL, 34 acute CSCR, total reported as 99); patient-level 75/25 holdout; 80% accuracy, AUC/PRC 0.92 on held-out 25 patients.
organization: Department of Neurosciences, Reproductive Sciences and Dentistry, University of Naples “Federico II”, 80138 Napoli, Italy; Department of Medicine, Surgery and Dentistry, University of Salerno, 84081 Baronissi, Italy
